summary: The one-per-machine embedder daemon: listens on socketPath() (newline JSON ops ping/status/embed/register/sketches-saved/notes-changed/touched/stop), loads the model via embed-model (download/verify) + embed-runtime, then pump() runs ONE inference at a time: queries first, then reconciles, then backfill items paced by COLDSTART_EMBEDDER_PACE (sleep = item time, cut short by a query). Idle exit after COLDSTART_EMBEDDER_IDLE_MS (default 90 min) only with no work; a 60 s watchdog exits on a stuck inference; self-reaps when its own file vanishes; an older PROTOCOL daemon is replaced, a newer one is never killed. Logs to ~/.coldstart/embedder/embedder.log, state.json every 2 s.

summary: The one-per-machine embedder daemon: listens on socketPath() (newline JSON ops ping/status/embed/register/sketches-saved/notes-changed/touched/stop) and runs the model in a worker thread (hooks/embed-worker.mjs) because onnxruntime-node's session.run blocks its thread — on the main thread the socket went silent during inference, clients thought the daemon dead and spawned a SECOND daemon writing the same store. pump() serialises: queries, then reconciles, then backfill items paced by COLDSTART_EMBEDDER_PACE. The 60 s watchdog terminates and reloads a stuck worker. listen() never steals a socket anyone still accepts on; shutdown() skips server.close() when the socket path's inode is no longer ours, because libuv's close unlinks the PATH and would delete a replacement daemon's socket. A model it cannot obtain → state model.failedAt + exit (clients cool down 10 min). A wiped store dir → the writer is reopened. Idle exit after COLDSTART_EMBEDDER_IDLE_MS (90 min) only with no work; self-reaps when its own file vanishes; an older PROTOCOL daemon is replaced, a newer one never killed.

summary: The per-machine embedder daemon: newline-JSON socket ops (ping/status/embed/register/sketches-saved/notes-changed/touched/stop) and background backfill of each registered repo into its vector store. The model never runs in this process: MAIN (backfill, plus queries when it is alone) and a query-only LANE are child processes forked from hooks/embed-worker.mjs, because a terminated worker_thread did not give ORT's arena back (measured 561 MB left vs 48 before load). Fixes a query that waited seconds behind a long note during backfill: long notes run one 2048-token window per call (plan/sums ops, pooled with poolSums, bit-identical to one call), and the lane starts when a query finds MAIN on an item over 1024 tokens or more than 8 items are queued (laneWorthIt), exits once backfill drains (laneCheck), and is replaced when its RSS passes fresh-load + RSS_MARGIN_MB. A lane whose oldest call is over 1 s old (hung/SIGSTOP) makes new and waiting queries also queue on MAIN; first answer wins via q.answered. MAIN is reloaded (load beside, swapMain, kill old) when every queue is empty, it grew past the margin and no lane is alive. kill() marks a model process dead SYNCHRONOUSLY — before that, after a watchdog kill the next item was sent to the dying process and lost; a failed item is retried once before being dropped. reconcile reads file sketches only with the opt-in (a gate-spawned daemon embeds NOTES only) and skips maybeSweep without sketches; loadRegistrations follows a re-registered cacheDir.

summary: The per-machine embedder daemon: newline-JSON socket ops (ping/status/embed/register/sketches-saved/notes-changed/touched/stop) and background backfill of each registered repo into its vector store. It holds the ONE tokenizer (embed-runtime loadTokenizer, Rust, loaded in parallel with MAIN's spawn in start()); the model runs in child processes forked from hooks/embed-worker.mjs that get token ids only (argv carries PROTOCOL; PROTOCOL 2 = this split). Every socket embed is planned here first (`tok.plan` per text, async) and the plans go to the lane or MAIN as one call; embedItem plans each backfill item (async: mainItemTokens is 0 while it tokenizes, then the 'a query came in while we tokenized → startLane' check), runs single-row plans as one embed call and long notes one 1024-token window per sums call, pooled with poolSums, so queries slot in between windows. MAIN = backfill, plus queries when alone; the query LANE starts when a query finds MAIN on an item over 1024 tokens or more than 8 items are queued (laneWorthIt), exits once backfill drains (laneCheck), and is replaced when its RSS passes fresh-load + RSS_MARGIN_MB. A lane whose oldest call is over 1 s old (hung/SIGSTOP) makes new and waiting queries also queue on MAIN; first answer wins via q.answered. MAIN is reloaded (load beside, swapMain, kill old) when every queue is empty, it grew past the margin and no lane is alive. kill() marks a model process dead SYNCHRONOUSLY (else the next item went to the dying process); a failed item is retried once. Measured M1 Pro 2026-11-22 (footprint, daemon + children, 193 notes, a query every 400 ms) before → after the tokenizer moved here: idle 415 → 223 MB, backfill peak 1029 → 724, after drain + reload 436 → 231, lane peak 483 → 204; backfill 133.8 s and query p50 ~120 ms unchanged; stored + query vectors byte-identical. A tokenizer that won't load → model unavailable → shutdown kills MAIN (no orphan).
